title: Upfirst Docs | MCP server and custom actions
description: Upfirst has no public REST API yet. Connect an AI assistant with the MCP server, or connect your receptionist to any tool that offers an API with custom actions.
blocks: We don't have a public API just yet. There are two ways to connect
Upfirst to the rest of your stack today.
Connect Upfirst to Claude, Cursor, or any assistant that speaks the
Model Context Protocol. Review calls, read transcripts, and manage
your receptionist's settings, skills, and knowledge from chat.
Connect your receptionist to any tool that offers an API. During a
call it can look something up or push data to another system, so
callers get real answers from your own records.
Looking for something else? Our help center covers
setting up your receptionist, and you can reach us from the chat widget
